name: zcode-tps-monitor
description: Real per-turn Token output-rate monitor for ZCode: reads the ZCode usage database and shows the just-finished turn's instant tokens/sec (incl. thinking tokens, TTFT, peak) via a Stop hook, with the previous turn's rate injected as context; includes a /tps-doctor self-check. Fully local, no network access.

description_i18n.en: Real per-turn Token output-rate monitor for ZCode: shows the just-finished turn's instant tokens/sec (from the ZCode usage DB) via a Stop hook, plus a /tps-doctor self-check. Fully local, no network access.
description_i18n.zh-CN: ZCode 真实 Token 输出速率监控:每轮回复结束自动显示本轮即时 tok/s(含思考 token、首字延迟、峰值),数据直接读取 ZCode usage 数据库;附 /tps-doctor 环境自检。纯本地运行,无任何对外访问。
